§3§lCreating and joining a team§r
Enter /gtnhteam to open GTNHLib's team interface. Create a team, invite players or accept an invitation to join.

§3§lShared wallet§r
GTIT automatically uses the shared team wallet after you join; no separate mode needs enabling. Personal balances remain separate and are not automatically transferred. Leaving restores access to your personal wallet.

§3§lCompletion§r
Read the team controls and fund-sharing rules, then tick the checkbox. Joining a team is not required by this quest.
